d:
Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya.
Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy (hi, Chirag ), things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough.
But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?
